snippet.title: [Mongil: STAR DIVE] Tokyo Game Show 2025 Trailer Reveal!
snippet.description:
📢Tokyo Game Show 2025 Trailer Reveal!

9/25 - 9/28!
The long-awaited TGS is finally here!

If you’re looking for deep storytelling and thrilling action,
don’t miss Mongil: STAR DIVE at TGS!

🚨 And here’s another very important announcement!
Recruitment for the Mongil: STAR DIVE 2nd Closed Beta Test has begun! 🎉

Curious about what kind of game Mongil: STAR DIVE is?
Head to the official website now and apply for the Closed Beta Test!

✨ Dive into a World of Wonder!
We ask for your continued interest and support! 💚

▶ Apply for the 2nd Closed Beta Test
https://stardive.netmarble.com/en/recruitment

#TGS2025 #MONGILSTARDIVE #STARDIVE #Mongil #MonsterTaming #Monster #Netmarble #ActionRPG #Game
